feature.label: General SEM PLS Higher-Order Full-Model Case Bootstrap

claim.supported_scope: Percentile Type-7 case-bootstrap inference for the exact bounded General SEM HOC point cell, with every compiled HOC stage refitted for each indexed complete-case sample.
claim.estimand: Bootstrap mean, bias, sample standard error, two-sided percentile interval, and plus-one probability for HOC component loadings or weights, authored structural paths touching the HOC, and extended-repeated total effects.
assumptions: The resident request satisfies the exact HOC point-cell predicate and its point result validates before resampling.
Every replicate reruns all required stages, aligns score directions, regenerates derived values, and validates the complete point target inventory.
All targets share one ordered success/failure ledger and the same usable replicate set.
exclusions: Inference for VIF, technical paths, controls, or unrelated ordinary structural paths is excluded.
BCa, studentized, one-sided, permutation, group, weighted, nested, multiple-HOC, hybrid, and HOC-interaction requests are excluded.
A partial replicate is never summarized and fewer than max(2, ceil(0.9B)) usable refits produces no inference.
warnings: Bootstrap intervals describe the bounded PLS procedure and are not causal guarantees.
Worker count is operational metadata; indexed replicate identities determine scientific replay.

equations.expression: SE = sqrt(sum_b(theta_b - mean(theta))^2/(B_u-1)); CI = Type7(theta, alpha/2, 1-alpha/2)

references.citation: Efron and Tibshirani (1993), An Introduction to the Bootstrap

simulations.design: Frozen HOC fixtures replay indexed full-model case refits across representative reflective and formative targets and supported worker counts.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario and replicate indexed draws; failed refits remain in the requested denominator.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Target identities, summaries, ordered failures, and usable indices replay exactly across supported workers and the usable gate is enforced.

boundaries.case: Fewer than max(2, ceil(0.9B)) complete refits are usable.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Publish no inference and retain the typed failure ledger.

boundaries.case: The request uses a non-percentile interval, unsupported tail, or excluded target.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Preflight blocks the request without changing the model.
Mapped target summaries and failure identities remain equivalent.

boundaries.case: The same seed is run with supported worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Scientific summaries, usable indices, and ordered failures are identical.

boundaries.case: A target, summary, failed replicate, count, stage digest, method, capability, or receipt is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Canonical and schema-6 validation reject the result.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose supplemental bootstrap cell or point dependency differs.
Reject a different bootstrap, stream, quantile, standard-error, or failure-policy version.
Reject a result bound to a different complete-case source.
Reject a changed target-set, usable-index, plan, or attachment digest.
Reject unknown, duplicate, nonfinite, unordered, partial, or contradictory bootstrap rows.
Never relabel historical HOC or point-only output as this bootstrap cell.

persistence.legacy_policy: This supplemental cell applies only beside its exact General SEM HOC point authority; existing projects retain their original identities.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same resident authority, seed, and worker-independent indexed schedule, every product surface reads the same canonical bootstrap result.
accessibility_rules: Intervals, probabilities, usable counts, and failures are available as accessible text and tables.
Point-only and inferred HOC rows are explicitly distinguished without relying on color.
